g.text: 04 / Actual message bus, publication and recovery
One broker; one unnamed direct default exchange. Queue-name routing is not a fan-out subscription or exactly-once transport.
Both producers and consumers use it
The two producer rows are separate routes through the same proxy and exchange. Both consumers forward invalid contracts to quarantine; successful outcomes
do not go there. Lost HTTP reply, publisher confirm and consumer ack have different recovery routines. There is no cross-database distributed transaction.
Source: packages/runtime/src/broker.ts; events.ts; owner inbox/outbox migrations; compose.yaml; infrastructure/toxiproxy.json
Static architecture; internal module cards are not additional processes. Full placement: drawing 07; live evidence: independent backend console.
